Alex H: Quick heads-up  GatewayX says theyre seeing demo leads from our EU marketplace and expect to own outreach. Who should follow up?

Maria C: Our standard has been marketplace -> BizDev/SDR initial contact; SI steps in for technical POCs when requested. GatewayX seems to want entitlement on introductions.

Samir P: Are these marketplace demo requests or partner referral submissions? Different entitlement.

Alex H: Demo request flow from marketplace listing; partner tag = GatewayX.

Jordan (SI Ops): Per their MSA, GatewayX can do technical discovery for introduced accounts, but Redwood must control contract routing. Proposed rule: if account ARR < 250k -> SI can lead initial POC; otherwise Redwood SDR qualifies first.

Kevin BD: Add a 48h outreach SLA: BizDev/SDR must contact within 48h of lead creation or partner may claim. 

Maria C: Ill create a Confluence mapping table: region, partner, ARR_threshold, default_owner, exceptions. I can seed EU/APAC.

Samir P: Add risk flags: NDA_needed, data_residency, on_prem_hw. GatewayX = on_prem_hw. Also include partner_claim_proof_url.

Alex H: For co-marketing asks, enforce a 2-week prep + product sign-off. Exceptions for strategic enterprise deals need PM+BizDev signoff.

Jordan (SI Ops): Routing pseudo-code:
- if (marketplace_lead && partner_tagged) assign_to = BizDev_primary;
- if (no_outreach_in_48h) partner_allowed_to_claim = true;
- if (account_ARR < partner_threshold) assign_to = SI_field_team;
- if (ARR within 20% of threshold) route to #partnerships-triage for human review.

Kevin BD: Require timestamped proof (screenshot of marketplace lead card) for partner claims to avoid disputes.

Maria C: Will add intake template, sample screenshot, CSV/JSON export example, and webhook payload sample.

Samir P: Add audit column for claim_proof_url and a freeform "how_verified" field. Instruct CS to cc partner rep on initial outreach when partner claims.

Alex H: Action items: Maria  create Confluence page + intake template by Friday; Jordan  update SI Ops playbook with thresholds and routing; Kevin  loop in Legal re: GatewayX MSA carveouts; Samir  add risk taxonomy and audit fields. Ill create #partnerships-triage and invite this group. :thumbsup:

announce-bot: Reminder  Partnership sync tomorrow 10:00am PT - https://cal.redwood/integrations

Alex H: Lets run this as a 30-day pilot and make schema machine-readable for intake automation.

Jordan (SI Ops): Also add an escalation path for contested claims: partnership ops review -> Legal arbitration for high ARR deals.

Samir P: We should backfill last 30 days of marketplace lead cards to see if this repeats.

Kevin BD: Ill contact GatewayX legal this afternoon.

Alex H: Thanks all, closing loop.
